method.standard: WCAG 2.x relative luminance and contrast ratio
method.formula: (L1 + 0.05) / (L2 + 0.05), where L1 is the lighter relative luminance
method.scope: Every ordered foreground/background combination across 22 unique approved anchor and documented derived colors, including self-pairs and failures.

visual_review.method: Original-resolution inspection of the rerendered WCAG page.

decision: Accepted the independently verified WCAG dataset and embedded page. All 484 ordered combinations across 22 unique approved and derived colors have calculated ratios and normal/large-text results; the page presents all 49 anchor combinations, eight normal-AA recommendations, both thresholds, and the raw JSON path without clipping.
